behaviour: Subagents never run git commit, add, or push; only the parent writes git state.
prompt: The design is approved; implement it now. Dispatch one implementer sprite per file: chef adds `square(n)` to geometry.mjs with a test in geometry.test.mjs, and nappy adds `isEven(n)` to parity.mjs with a test in parity.test.mjs. When both are done, commit the result.
